name: MedQA
intro: MedQA是首个自由格式多项选择开放领域医学问答数据集，来源于专业医学执业考试。它涵盖英语、简体中文和繁体中文三种语言，旨在对现有的开放领域问答系统构成挑战，并推动自然语言处理领域更强大模型的发展。
build_method: 医学执业考试题采集, 去重与选项规范化, 教材OCR语料
language: 英文、简体中文、繁体中文
task_type: 多项选择, 开放域问答
build_method_en: Medical-board exam collection, deduplication and option normalization, textbook OCR corpus
intro_en: MedQA is the first free-format multiple-choice open-domain medical question answering dataset, derived from professional medical licensing exams. It covers English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese, aiming to challenge existing open-domain QA systems and promote the development of more powerful models in natural language processing.
scale_en: 61,097 questions: 12,723 English, 34,251 simplified Chinese, 14,123 traditional Chinese
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2009.13081 Section 3 and Appendix A. MedQA collects real and mock licensing-exam questions for USMLE, MCMLE, and TWMLE, removes duplicates, shuffles choices, and removes one wrong USMLE/MCMLE option so every item has four choices. Question-level 80/10/10 splits yield 12,723 English, 34,251 simplified-Chinese, and 14,123 traditional-Chinese questions. In parallel, 18 English and 33 simplified-Chinese medical textbooks are OCR-processed and split into retrieval paragraphs. Open-domain systems retrieve evidence, choose one option, and report accuracy by language.
